$comment: WebCoder coverage SSOT. Single-branch layout since 2026-10-27: Next.js frontend at the repo ROOT and Django backend under backend/. Thresholds are 100 per task spec. enforcement.command entries mirror the CI gate commands in .github/workflows/frontend.yml and django.yml. The backend 100 percent line floor is now mechanically enforced in CI (django.yml runs pytest with --cov-fail-under=100 via the root pytest.ini); vitest.config.ts has no coverage.thresholds block, so the frontend floor remains orchestrator-enforced.

command: npm ci && npm run build && npx vitest run --coverage
pip install -r backend/deps.txt && SECRET_KEY=x DB_PASSWORD=x python -m pytest -q --cov-fail-under=100
enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds for both surfaces before marking any task complete or creating a PR. Commands must exit 0 and measured coverage must meet thresholds.lines/branches/functions/statements at 100. Both commands run from the repo root on the single branch.
